consumer.use: Use three reviewed pilot outcomes to decide whether the deterministic effect evaluator is promoted, kept as a pilot, deferred, rejected or archived.

decision_target.question: Should the Vibe-Lab effect evaluator remain an active reusable experiment tool after three real operator-intervention pilots?

intervention.name: deterministic_effect_report
intervention.description: Provide an evidence-bound deterministic effect report in addition to the same underlying pilot evidence.

control_condition.description: A reviewer decides from the registered pilot evidence without seeing the evaluator report.

treatment_condition.description: A separate reviewer decides from the same evidence plus the deterministic evaluator report.

measurement.method: For each real pilot, compare independently recorded manual and evaluator-assisted decisions for calibration, non-obvious diagnostic value and absence of overclaiming.
measurement.success: At least one material reviewed decision improvement across three real pilots without a misleading effect claim.
measurement.falsification: No material decision improvement, any misleading effect claim, or ceremony exceeding the decision value.

comparison.unit: same pilot evidence reviewed under manual and evaluator-assisted conditions
